g.text: Growth curves for boys and girls, from birth to age 19

text.style: font-size: 10.08px; font-family: 'Lato', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #555555

g.text: Growth standards (under age 5) and growth reference (ages 5 to 19) of the World Health Organization.

text.style: font-size: 7.75px; font-family: 'Lato', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; fill: #777777

g.text: Note: A child is considered stunted if their height is more than two standard deviations below the median for children of the same age, shown here by the lower edge of the

text.style: font-size: 7.75px; font-family: 'Lato', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; fill: #777777

g.text: shaded area. In the reference population, roughly 2.3% of children fall below this cutoff.
